levels.surface: عبد الله بن عبد، الرحمن الدارمي

notes: «قالا جميعا حدثنا سليمان بن بلال» : the two branches meet at سليمان بن بلال, so the names after it are the shared tail.
«أنه سأل جابر» : the asker is أبيه (the father of Ja'far), a relation link, and Jabir is the one asked and answering, so he is the last link.
«زاد عبد الله في حديثه» is an addition of wording by a transmitter already in the chain; it is left out.
